messages:
sandeep: Need approval to open GCP GPU/TPU quota and create project-level service account for a cross-team burst pool. Teams: research, recommender, and infra. Target regions: us-west1 + europe-west4. Requesting A100 (40GB) x8, H100 x4, L4 x16 across projects. Also need VPC peering egress bump (10Gb -> 25Gb) for west1.
alex: Do you have exact project IDs and quota numbers per project? we should split so prod/research don't hit same quota pool. :thinking_face:
sandeep: proj-research-2026, proj-reco-prod, proj-infra-shared. Per-project targets: research: L4 x8, H100 x2; reco-prod: A100 x6, L4 x4; infra-shared: H100 x2, L4 x4. Total matches earlier numbers. Need quota increase for GPUs and CPUs, plus TPUs reserved for eval runs (TPU v4 small: 2 nodes in eu-west4).
maya: cost flag — if we approve A100 x6 constant that will burn credits. can we request burst capacity only, or convert some to preemptible/spot? prefer burst + spot where possible. :money_with_wings:
harper: For latency-sensitive stuff (reco-prod) we should keep guaranteed A100, but we can run other batches on spot. Also consider Dedicated pools rather than adding to project quotas — can we route through dedicated when high load?
sandeep: Good call. Plan: reserve A100 x4 guaranteed for reco-prod, allow A100 x2 as burst preemptible. Research gets L4 guaranteed x6, H100 x1 guaranteed + H100 x1 burst. infra-shared will be flexible L4 spot x4. Still need quota change with GCP support for the guaranteed numbers. Also need to create service account: infra-gpu-onboarding@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com with roles: compute.viewer, compute.quotaRequester (custom), servicenetworking.admin for peering automation.
infra-bot: Ticket created: GCP-QUOTA-78523. Assigned to eng-infra. ETA from cloud support: ~48-72h. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/78523alex: I can own the project creation + IAM. sandeep can you post the exact gcloud commands you want us to run? i will need permissions from security to create the service account in org-level projects.
sandeep: Sure, minimal commands (example): ``` # create service account gcloud iam service-accounts create infra-gpu-onboarding --project=proj-infra-shared # assign roles gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding proj-infra-shared --member="serviceAccount:infra-gpu-onboarding@proj-infra-shared.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/compute.viewer" # request quota via support API (org-level ticket created) ``` I'll attach full JSON quota spec to the support ticket.
maya: add a note to ticket about egress peering and firewall rules. We had a broken peering last quarter due to missing routes. :warning:
harper: On dedicated pool angle, i'll open a follow-up to estimate monthly commit vs on-demand cost. If Dedicated cheaper for steady A100 x4 we'll move reco-prod into that pool and only use quota for burst. keep this thread for the quota request itself.
devx: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gcp-quota-onboarding. make sure service account follows least-privilege. suggest using short-lived keys + KMS bound to project. Also add a monitoring alert for quota utilization > 70% for 1h. waiting on internal approval. Activity log: sandeep added quota JSON, alex added service account details.
sandeep: thanks everyone. i'll ping again once support confirms. will also add a canary plan for warm-up to avoid cold-start throttles.
